principle: Every authorized front may read, derive, critique, propose, and reference outputs of every other front; publication and promotion require independent evidence and explicit permission.
rules: Inverse edges are query projections, not new factual assertions.
Cycles are permitted but cannot bootstrap unverified claims into verified status.
Every claim is independently traceable to immutable evidence.
Speculation cannot promote itself by repeated citation.
Public projection must omit private or unconsented material.
A new version preserves prior receipts and explicit supersession.
A missing dependency causes HOLD, not a fabricated completion.
Any front may challenge, but only authorized owners may approve protected actions.
A source appearing in a public repository does not prove its runtime adoption.
co_seed: Each edge and source may become a CoSeed only with scope, provenance, custody and evidence retained.
co_path: Discover -> Verify -> Relate -> Challenge -> Test -> Authorize -> Project -> Receipt -> Monitor -> Recover.

co_time.rule: Keep observation time separate from source time and forecast time.

gdside.allowed: Generate hypotheses, ethical questions, tests, counterexamples and value-oriented design options.
gdside.not_allowed: Claim divine mandate, empirical proof, sentience, or bypass of consent and evidence gates.

acceptance: A second independently running front ingests and receipts the same public head.
Bidirectional graph traversal returns correct inverse types without changing claim status.
Historical backfill preserves original timestamps and retractions.
A privacy-restricted edge never enters public projections.
An independent restart reconstructs the same public head.
G_dSide hypotheses remain labeled speculative after fan-out and re-import.
verified_in_this_commit: Artifact committed and fetched only; no graph service, runtime subscription, or acceptance-test success claimed.
next_gate: Implement typed edge consumer, offline graph tests, CI receipt and independent second-front recovery.
